about: Where each place sits, shapes first (CONTEXT.md "outside shell", "inside place"): `within` names the outside place or shell holding a place, `from` the data it was read from; a place not listed is an outside place of its own. `shells` are outside shells that are no place of their own yet (no plan): their inside places are. `parts` are parts of an outside place's own outside (`of`), drawn in its concept (`as`) and grouped under it, no place of their own to the creator and none in the build: no card, no stage line; the scene it is part of builds it, its inventory rows and plan area that scene's design (the owner, 2026-10-21, to "Shall Launch stop being a place the batch builds, so the Square's build covers it?": "yes"; score/stages/__init__.py places). `merged` are places the creator merged into another (`into`): no place to him, no card and no concept anywhere; their stage rows still run as places until the route folds them in. Derived by hand from the plans on 2026-10-20 (#42); no plan has a shell split yet (#16), which replaces this once it does. Read by the cockpit (score/dashboard/state/local.py), the concept review's wording (score/review/concepts.py: a place's first draw names the places listed under it, and a place within another is drawn on that one's picked concept) and, of the stages, the stage table's places (merged and parts left out), the neighbours stage (a part is no neighbour) and the sound stage's bed (score/stages/sound/beds.py: the outside place, and so the site and body, holding a scene).
